-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #3 - Function talkevent2_1
function talkevent2_1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(0)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town000D.map")
	MoveCamera(328.19, 161.99, 101.02)
	RotCamera(4.96, 1.51, 109.34)


	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 3)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(talkevent2_1)
